maria_support: FYI customer 'CoinDesk' reports p99 ~4.2s and intermittent 500s (auth) starting ~09:00 UTC after a traffic burst. They attached a few request ids: req_abc123, req_def456. Can we triage?

ashish_sre: Ack. Pls drop a curl sample and any request headers you have. I'll look at autoscale events.

maria_support: sample curl:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input": "hello"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Response snippets: 
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
content-type: application/json
{"error": "auth_service_error"}
```

deploy-bot: autoscaler: dedicated-nyc pool scaled up +3 instances at 08:58:12 UTC (reason: burst_attach_rate).

liam_runtime: Looking at metrics now — attach latency jumped at 08:58. Attach p99 ~2.8s (many cold_gpu starts), inference p99 ~1.4s -> explains ~4.2s total. Also seeing auth 5xx spikes during warmup window.

jessica_pms: Customer on Dedicated-nyc reserved pool? Any recent config changes?

maria_support: Yes on Dedicated-nyc, no config changes from customer side. They've been hitting a sudden burst of concurrent attach requests (~x20 their normal).

ashish_sre: I can repro a sequence: heavy attach fanout => many attach workers call auth-service/token-fetch concurrently. Auth-service has a per-client token API that is being overwhelmed; it's returning 500 when upstream KMS times out. Stack traces show: 
```
AuthError: token_fetch_timeout at auth-service/token.go:212
```
This lines up with autoscaler creating new machines and each attach calling auth concurrently.

liam_runtime: Root cause seems to be combined: (1) thundering herd on attach during scale-up, (2) cold GPU warmup adds latency, (3) auth-service not backpressuring attach path.

ashish_sre: Short-term mitigations to propose: 
- Enable per-customer attach rate limiting + queuing (cap concurrent attach to 8)
- Turn on fallback routing for this customer to hosted pool (lower latency)
- Increase auth-service token cache TTL for dedicated pool tokens (reduces token_fetch frequency)

liam_runtime: I can enable fallback routing for CoinDesk now (route to hosted-small). That will reduce load on Dedicated-nyc while we patch. Will take ~5m to roll.

maria_support: Please do, customer is OK with temporary fallback. I'll notify them. :thumbsup:

ashish_sre: I'll patch auth-service to add basic leaky-bucket per-client on token fetch and increase retry jitter to avoid synchronized retries. Deploy plan: feature flag on, monitor 15m. Owner: ashish_sre.

liam_runtime: Also recommending we pre-warm a small number of GPUs on scale events for dedicated pools (warmup_concurrency config -> increase from 2 to 6). That should cut attach p99 by ~1.5s in our charts. I'll open a follow-up PR.

jessica_pms: For the customer update: communicate root cause (attach surge + auth throttle) and the temporary fallback + ETA for fix. Keep them updated every 30m.

ashish_sre: Quick repro steps for SREs: 
1) simulate burst: run 200 concurrent attach requests to dedicated-nyc (use load-test script)
2) watch auth-service /token endpoint errors
3) observe attach p99 in datadog dashboard: infra.attach.latency.p99

Example attach command:
```
for i in {1..200}; do \
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"rtd-large"}' https://internal.attach.redwood/v1/attach &
 done
```

liam_runtime: I'll flip the fallback now. Ashish please coordinate the auth-service flag after fallback is live so we can see effect.

deploy-bot: rollout: routing-rule coin_desk_fallback -> hosted-small started at 09:10:02 UTC

maria_support: Customer notified, they're switching traffic now and seeing reduced 5xxs at their side. :relieved:

ashish_sre: Patch deployed behind flag. Enabling for dedicated-nyc test cluster first. Monitoring auth 5xx and attach p99.

liam_runtime: Early numbers: attach p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.1s on fallback path. Customer overall p99 ~0.9s now.

maria_support: Great. Next steps/owners: 
- ashish_sre: implement per-client token fetch backpressure and increase token-cache TTL (in progress)
- liam_runtime: PR for warmup_concurrency bump + Terraform for pre-warm instances (in review)
- maria_support: continue customer comms every 30m until stable

jessica_pms: Please add post-incident note with timeline + config changes. We'll include mitigation as playbook item for future scale bursts.

ashish_sre: Will follow up with remediation PR link and metrics snapshot.

maria_support: Thanks team. Closing this thread once metrics stable for 1h.
